about: This machine's paths. Copy to project.json (gitignored) and fill them in; forward slashes are fine on Windows.

game.about: The Borderlands 2 install (the folder holding Binaries/, WillowGame/, DLC/, sdk_mods/).

tps.about: Optional. The Pre-Sequel install, to link the mod there too: python tools/link_mod.py tps.

bl1.about: Optional. Borderlands 1 (the original 2009 game, not Enhanced: the Python SDK runs there), to link the mod there too: python tools/link_mod.py bl1.

gibbed.about: Optional. A clone of Gibbed.Borderlands2 (https://github.com/gibbed/Gibbed.Borderlands2, with its Resources/Dumps submodule).

gibbed_oz.about: Optional. A clone of Gibbed.BorderlandsOz, the Pre-Sequel's save editor (https://github.com/gibbed/Gibbed.BorderlandsOz, with its Resources/Dumps submodule).
